name: Alphalete - Blog Index
body:
> Index · Alphalete · 2026-07-21

Also: `Alphalete-Blog-Inventory-2026-07-21.xlsx` / `.csv`, `Alphalete - Blog Content Plan & Tracker.xlsx`, `Alphalete - Website Pages & Blog Tracker.xlsx`, `Blogs\`, `Batch 1\`, `Batch 2\`

# Summary
Index of Alphalete blog content. Note on scale: a June 16 inventory counted only **6 posts and 237 pages**, but the blog grew fast. The Jul 21 inventory counts **52 posts** (50 published, 1 draft, 1 private, 49,536 words, average 953) dated May 4 to Jul 20, and the Oct 1 handoff says about 50 published under `/blog/` (one category, Articles). Later posts (Aug to Sep) are listed below from the handoff.

# Cluster notes
- [Alphalete - Blog Batches 1 and 2 2026-06](lib:brain-alphalete-blog-batches-1-and-2-2026-06): 10 core posts (what-is, vs traditional, CIPP vs bursting, signs, how long, cracked vs collapsed, gurgling, recurring backups, how often hydro jet, hydro jetting cast iron).
- [Alphalete - Cast Iron Cluster 2026-07](lib:brain-alphalete-cast-iron-cluster-2026-07): pillar + 4, published Jul 13.
- [Alphalete - Monsoon Cluster 2026-07](lib:brain-alphalete-monsoon-cluster-2026-07): pillar + 4, published Jul 20.
- [Alphalete - Hydro Jetting Cluster 2026-08](lib:brain-alphalete-hydro-jetting-cluster-2026-08): pillar + 4 drafted for August.
- [Alphalete - Blog Elementor Fixes 2026-06-12](lib:brain-alphalete-blog-elementor-fixes-2026-06-12): June edits to batch posts.

# Posts by topic (Jul 21 tracker, titles shortened)
| Topic | Posts |
|---|---|
| Trenchless sewer repair | What is trenchless sewer repair; Trenchless vs traditional; CIPP vs pipe bursting; Signs you need sewer line repair; How long does trenchless repair take; Cracked vs collapsed (2 versions); Tree roots in sewer line; Sewer line repair without digging |
| Sewer backups and warning signs | Basement floor drain backing up; Sewage smell in the house; Backed up sewer line symptoms; Toilet gurgling; Recurring sewer line backups; Gurgling drains and sewer smells (2 versions); Why sewer line keeps backing up; Colorado Springs sewer line causes |
| Drain cleaning and hydro jetting | How often to hydro jet; Hydro jetting cast iron; Hydro jetting Colorado Springs guide; Hydro jetting cost Colorado Springs; Hydro jetting vs drain snake; Why does my drain keep clogging; Is hydro jetting safe for cast iron; DIY vs professional drain cleaning; How to prevent clogged drains |
| Cast iron and materials | Cast iron cluster (5); Why clay and cast iron pipes fail in Colorado Springs |
| Seasonal and weather | Monsoon cluster (5); Sewer backup when it rains (Jul 6); Preparing your sewer line for winter |

| Camera inspection | Sewer camera inspection Colorado Springs; Sewer scope before buying a home; What does a sewer camera inspection find |
| Commercial | Commercial trenchless pipelining Colorado Springs; Commercial sewer repair for property managers; Trenchless vs excavation business disruption |
| Maintenance | Home sewer maintenance checklist |

# Added after Jul 21 (per the Oct 1 handoff)
Denver batch 15724 to 15727 (Aug 13 to 19, including who-pays and clay pipe Denver), insurance post 15799 (Sep 7), Colorado sewer-responsibility guide 15885 (Sep 21/22), trenchless-vs-traditional rewrite (Sep 17). Drafts waiting: Orangeburg pipe 15864, CIPP cost Denver 14301, draft 12689.

# Duplicates flagged (Jul 21 inventory)
12688 and 13469 (gurgling drains); 12687 and 13468 (cracked vs collapsed); 13550 and 14279 (identical "sewer back up when it rains" title). Sep 15 merges: expansive-soil into expansive-clay; sewer-line-repair-without-digging into what-is.

# Planning workbooks
- `Alphalete - Blog Content Plan & Tracker.xlsx` (Jun 10): 30 planned topics, 6 created, 24 planned, with a cannibalization check (2 high, 2 medium risk).
- `Alphalete - Website Pages & Blog Tracker.xlsx` (Jun 10): all 237 links by category plus a blogs tab and the same cannibalization check.
- `Alphalete-Blog-Inventory-2026-07-21` and `Alphalete-Blog-Tracker-2026-07-21` (xlsx + csv): post-level inventory and tracker with publish date, keyword, category, URL, indexed flag.

# Open items
- What-is post 12681 position drop after its Sep 16 rewrite (decision due Oct 2).
- 49 of 50 posts lack Article schema (Step 3 of [Alphalete - Lesson Fix Steps 2026-10-08](lib:brain-alphalete-lesson-fix-steps-2026-10-08)).
- Typed phone numbers in about 31 blog bodies; 3 posts kept old keywords (13476, 13480, 13483).
